title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1970-02-02
lineage: SBD > Bill Gadsen Reels > C > DAT > WAV > SHN

ai_review.summary: Mixed soundboard quality but a transcendent Dark Star makes this show worth the listen.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the 28‑minute Dark Star that soars on this recording, calling it “utterly transcendent” and perfect for the band’s improvisational flow. The soundboard, however, divides opinion – some hear a unique acoustic character that enhances the performance, while others describe it as the worst‑sounding board in the archive.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently praised (especially Dark Star) giving a high musical score, while recording quality is split; weighted average yields a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note an unusual acoustic character – some describe it as “perfect for Dark Star,” others call it muffled and liken it to a cockroach in a sewer pipe. No clear consensus on clarity; the mix is described as both “different” and “spot‑on.”

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set features an unusual run of four Jerry‑lead songs in a row (including Mason's Children, Lovelight, etc.), which reviewers find intriguing and indicative of the band’s high energy after a recent busted show.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers highlight his tone, interplay and the transcendent nature of his Dark Star improvisation.
